blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: A model is a simplified way of looking at a complex problem or situation that helps us understand, explain or predict how things work, focusing on the most important parts and leaving out unnecessary details, just as a map shows roads and landmarks.
A student's study plan is a model: it simplifies the schedule by focusing on important subjects and ignoring less relevant tasks.
